episode: "57: The Truth About Colt, Part Two

question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Should Sam and Colt stay together?

nodes.text: Sam holds Jessica up despite her bad grip!
At the top, $ZOE and Jessica cheer with the rest of the crowd, then flip down.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Go, Lizards!
The cheerleaders run to the side as the gym empties.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great work, girls!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And you'll be okay, Sam. You kept Jessica up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, just hope you do as good a job hanging on to Colt. He looks really cozy over there.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: You guys done back there? Watch the movie!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine.
Sam, $ZOE, and Howard watch the rest of the movie in silence.
As they come out of the theater...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where did Colt go?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not sure.
Suddenly, Sam receives a text.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's from Colt.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Sorry. Something came up. Howard drive you back?'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Colt's not coming back?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, gloat all you want.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam... I don't want to gloat. It's not a contest. Come on, Howard'll take us home.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I bet it's something really important.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It'd better be...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, $ZOE, I told you. He's not the same guy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He isn't? So you've talked about what happened in the park a few months ago? And at Monarch Prep?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then what's changed? He sounds exactly like the type of guy that left you in the park...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Put you in detention...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And got you expelled just so he could steal Tom Prince's limo.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's not fair.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Sam, I don't want to talk badly about Colt, but you deserve better.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're the one that told me to talk to him about our relationship.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, talk. Not `get back together.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes, talk. Not [color=#3b78e2][i]get back together.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, you might be right. I thought he'd changed, but he's still the guy that ditched me in the park to steal Tom Prince's limo.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He does seem to abandon you a lot.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe you girls should cut him some slack.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Colt cares about you plenty, Sam. He just does it in his own Colt way.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Remember that time when he forgot a date, and the next time he snuck you into your favorite concert to make up for it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That wasn't entirely legal...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But it was thoughtful. And fun. At least, according to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Howard, you really do listen to me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm just saying that maybe he's going through a rough time, and until you figure out what that is, give him some space.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, Howard. That makes me feel better.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How about we go inside and grab seats?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good idea.
In the middle of the movie...
Colt's phone rings!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Turn that thing off!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Lay off, would you?
Colt stands up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Where are you going? This is the best part!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sorry, I have to take this.
Colt leaves the theater.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He's not going to leave you again, is he?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You got this, Colt?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course. I'm here to take care of you, Sammy.
Colt pays for the tickets.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aw, how sweet!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, isn't he?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait, did you want me to pay for your tickets? I thought that wasn't cool anymore... Did it become cool again? It's been a while since I took one of Hector's classes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, shh. You're plenty sweet too.
Sam puts money down on the ticket counter.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What are you doing? I got this.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just thought that...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You think I can't afford it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! I just wasn't sure.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't mean to insult you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Forget about it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor seems to be really mad at you these days.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She's just mad that I dated Colt.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If Taylor's that mad, wouldn't she kick you off the team?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She won't. If she does that, then she can't boss me around or tell me to do whatever she wants.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And you don't mind because...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Think about it, $ZOE. Would you quit cheerleading even if Taylor were giving you a hard time?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: After all that hard work getting on the squad? Baking all those cookies? Going shopping with Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We did practice all those jumps and kicks really hard. And we were competing against each other at the time too!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: See? I can't quit the team.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And it is really nice being recognized in the hallways since we're part of the squad.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're right. Hang in there, Sam. Taylor can't stay mad forever.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: At least I have a date with Colt to look forward to...
Later, at the movie theater...
Sam and $ZOE run up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Howard, sorry we're late. Taylor made me stay behind to clean up all by myself.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And $ZOE was nice enough to help.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's okay. I've just been waiting in line for tickets.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm really excited about this movie. The movie looks awesome.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Seriously! I heard the scene where the zombies attack the orphanage is `brutal!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Seriously! I heard the scene where the zombies attack the orphanage is [color=#e23b3b][i]brutal![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, this movie sounds scary!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Chill, $ZOE. `Surviving Zombies` is going to be a gory movie, not scary one.
nodes.text_bbcode: Chill, $ZOE. [color=#3b78e2][i]Surviving Zombies[/i][/color] is going to be a gory movie, not scary one.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's worse, not better!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you worried about? Your boyfriend's here to take care of you... And I don't have to third-wheel it this time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You sure Colt's coming? It's getting late...
Colt walks up.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, babe.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: See? There he is.
Sam and Colt kiss and get back into line.
A couple minutes later, at the ticket booth...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Two tickets for 'Surviving Zombies' please.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: That'll be ten dollars.
Sam and Colt look at each other.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It'll look better if he pays. But maybe I should offer...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nice to see you're enthusiastic. Have fun, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Anyway, I've got to run. Hot date tonight.
Taylor exits, leaving the other cheerleaders behind.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so sorry, Sam... Taylor is being totally unfair! It's going to take you an hour at least to iron `everyone's` uniforms!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm so sorry, Sam... Taylor is being totally unfair! It's going to take you an hour at least to iron [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone's[/i][/color] uniforms!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Washing machines make me dizzy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're not upset about it, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, yeah. But it seems like Taylor's always mad at someone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess it's just my turn this week.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I remember when Taylor was mad at me for copying her hair color.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Her hair color? Aren't you both blonde?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Exactly... She made me wear a sombrero for a week!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And I remember when she ruined my yearbook picture because I gave her an accidental makeover.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Accidental?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You know, fake tan lotion and sunblock come in bottles that look `exactly` the same. She was only orange for a week, but...
nodes.text_bbcode: You know, fake tan lotion and sunblock come in bottles that look [color=#3b78e2][i]exactly[/i][/color] the same. She was only orange for a week, but...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: The point is, we all know what it's like having Taylor mad at us.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It sucks?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If you want, Sam, I don't mind ironing my own uniform.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, me neither.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? You don't have to, but I won't say 'no.'
Some of the cheerleaders stay behind to help Sam, and half an hour later...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: There! All done! Taylor might still be mad, but at least you're done with the ironing!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, guys!
$ZOE and Sam head home to get ready for their date.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whew! I'm glad that's over.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Maybe, but if you want to `stick with` the team, you have to `do chores` for the team.
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe, but if you want to [color=#3b78e2][i]stick with[/i][/color] the team, you have to [color=#3b78e2][i]do chores[/i][/color] for the team.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Anyway, I've got to run. Hot date tonight.
Taylor exits, leaving the other cheerleaders behind.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's so unfair! I'm going to be stuck here for another hour at least!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, duh. Of course, it's unfair.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But that's part of being a cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, you're not really a true cheerleader until you've ruined Taylor's shoes, and she's made you lug around Lyle the Lizard to every class out of spite!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Or when you spill something on her, and she makes you do the dry cleaning for her entire family for a month!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Taylor's done this to all of us at one point. It sucks, but it's just your turn, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: And it's something you get to experience by yourself.
All the cheerleaders except $ZOE leave.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's like a rite of passage.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Or torture.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That too. I'll stay and help.
A couple hours later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're done!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Finally! My back hurts from standing over the ironing board.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm just glad that's over. And we have just enough time to make it to the theater!
$ZOE and Sam head home.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This isn't working! Maybe if I move a little to the right...
Sam tries to get a better grip... And drops Jessica!
Jessica falls, taking $ZOE with her!
The entire pyramid falls apart, as the crowd watches.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And that's our routine! Good luck, Centerscore basketball team! Hope you knock the other team over. Like we did here.
The cheerleaders run to the side as the gym empties.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That was terrible, `Sam!` It's like you've never held up a pyramid before!
nodes.text_bbcode: That was terrible, [color=#3b78e2][i]Sam![/i][/color] It's like you've never held up a pyramid before!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Actually, Taylor, I haven't...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, work on it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just hope you hold on to Colt better than you held on to Jessica. He looks really cozy over there.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Trust me, don't worry about this.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I still get the feeling he's hiding something... But I want to trust him.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And it sucks that Taylor's giving you a hard time. Tell you what, I'll come to your pep rally or whatever.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know how that will help.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'll be there supporting you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Now, come on. Let's get you home before it gets so late, your mother calls the police... Again.
The next week, right before the school pep rally...
Sam and Colt walk into the gym.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sitting up in the bleachers, cheering people on isn't really my style. But I'll be here.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, Colt. I appreciate it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If I don't see you after the rally, I'll meet you at the movie theater later, okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure.
Colt sits in the bleachers as Hannah and Mona walk by Sam.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Colt is so `hot.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt is so [color=#3b78e2][i]hot.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, I'd like to take a ride on his motorcycle.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Hannah!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What? I mean it. His motorcycle is awesome. Let's go sit next to him! Come on!
Before Sam can say anything, $ZOE waves Sam over.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam! Hurry up!
Sam runs to where all the cheerleaders are huddled.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nice to see you enjoy being part of the team, Sam. Would it kill you to be here on time?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, you should be. As of today, you're in charge of carrying all the team uniforms, setting up all our equipment, and washing Lyle!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Washing Lyle?! Eww...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Taylor, if this is about dating Colt... I'm really sorry it happened the way it did.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sorry? Please. I wasn't `really` serious about that low-life. He's hot, but he's definitely not boyfriend material.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry? Please. I wasn't [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] serious about that low-life. He's hot, but he's definitely not boyfriend material.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Really, with half the girls throwing themselves at him, how long do you think it'll take before he cheats on you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I... Colt wouldn't...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sure, sweetie.
Sam looks for Colt in the bleachers and sees him next to Hannah and Mona.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Hey there, handsome... So you know, I've always wanted to go for a ride on a motorcycle. What are you doing tonight?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: See what I mean?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now, girls. We're here to show support for the basketball game.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I thought that was last week!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The basketball players have more than one game, Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And this isn't like last time. We're just doing some cheering and the basic pyramid. Most of you know where you need to be...Except for Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? I'm not on the pyramid anymore?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're the `most important part!` You're at the base!
nodes.text_bbcode: You're the [color=#3b78e2][i]most important part![/i][/color] You're at the base!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I switched the places last night. It's not fair that you get to be on top all the time while Jessica always has to support you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Finally! I'm moving up in the world... Or at least on a pyramid.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And this isn't about Colt?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! We're a cheer-o-cracy after all. Taxation without representation, am I right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That doesn't make any sense.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, whatever. Ready, girls?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And, Sam, `don't screw this up.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And, Sam, [color=#3b78e2][i]don't screw this up.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The cheerleaders run out into the center of the gym and start cheering.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Go Lizards!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Go Lizards!
The cheerleaders start building the pyramid. Sam struggles to hold up Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Unff! This is a harder than it looks... And my hand is slipping...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I can show Taylor! I have to keep the pyramid up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, I was just curious. I don't get to see you that much when we're in school, and you just got a million texts.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just want to know what's going on in your life. I don't want to miss out on anything.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Never want to be left out, huh?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But seriously, you're not missing anything. I'd tell you if something interesting was going down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, I was just worried.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Worried about what?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: About us. We just got back together, and I'm still trying to figure things out with you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then suddenly you get a million texts from someone else, and you don't think I'm worried?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I told you it's nothing. Maybe it does look messy, but...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now, what does his phone say?
Sam looks at Colt's phone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'cant wait 2 c u tonite!'... 'Can't wait to see you tonight?'

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who would text him `that?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Who would text him [color=#3b78e2][i]that?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I don't know. Maybe you should check the caller name.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Spy much?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You know that guy you pointed out? He was just admiring my bike's paint job.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The guy is really into bikes, I guess. His name is Craig. He seems all right. We're gonna hang out some time.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But the point is, I can't believe you spied on me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You wasted a perfectly good soda for this? I was going to drink half of that!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sammy, I knew you were crazy, but I didn't think you were that kind of crazy.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What kind?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The kind that sneaks around reading her boyfriend's texts.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not. It's just... You weren't listening to a thing I was saying.
Colt's phone rings!
Colt snatches his phone back and checks it for another text.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So who are you seeing tonight?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No one, Sam. I'm just going home.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: `Really,` Sam. It's my private life. Sorry if I wasn't listening, but something came up. And I have to deal with it.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Really,[/i][/color] Sam. It's my private life. Sorry if I wasn't listening, but something came up. And I have to deal with it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Colt. I was...
Sam knocks over her can of soda. It spills all over her dress!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Eeek! That's cold!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You know soda's supposed to go in your mouth, not on your lap.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you going to help out or what?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Fine... There might be a wash rag in my motorcycle. I'll get it.
Colt runs off, leaving his phone behind.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, that was embarrassing, but at least it worked...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, look over there!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? What am I looking at?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There's a guy over by your motorcycle!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I see him... So?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... I saw that guy walking around the parking lot earlier, scratching motorcycles!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I mean... Yeah, it looks like he's trying to scratch it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? Are you serious? No one messes with my paint job and lives!
Colt grabs a rock and runs off to investigate, leaving his phone behind.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I hope that guy will be okay...

nodes.title: The Truth About Colt, Part Two
nodes.subtitle: The answer to Colt's secret!

nodes.text: In our last episode, Colt and Sam decided to work things out!
A week later, in the park...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, Colt. I'm impressed. Our first real date since we broke up, and you pulled out all the stops.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Lake-side dinner by flashlight, hot dogs, your leather jacket to sit on... Classy.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can be classy.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I went through a lot of trouble to take these picnic supplies while the other couple wasn't looking, babe.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt! Please tell me you didn't actually `steal` these!
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt! Please tell me you didn't actually [color=#3b78e2][i]steal[/i][/color] these!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Of course not. This picnic is a Colt original.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha. Very sweet. Thanks for taking me out here. I needed to get away from things.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Problems?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: One problem. Taylor. $ZOE told me she was really upset after we ran off together.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just know she has something in store for me on Monday. Almost makes me not want to go to school.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So don't go to school.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just a suggestion.
Colt's phone beeps. He looks at the message and texts back.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sorry, Sam. What's the worst Taylor can do to you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Lots of things. She's the head cheerleader. If she told me to clean the bathroom with a toothbrush, I'd have to do it.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If it gets that bad, you can always quit, right?
Colt's phone rings again, and Colt looks at his phone and texts back.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Something important?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Kind of. You were saying?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I was going to say that I can't just `quit`...
nodes.text_bbcode: I was going to say that I can't just [color=#3b78e2][i]quit[/i][/color]...

nodes.text: Colt receives another text!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, who are you talking to?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No one you'd be interested in.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? I'm pretty interested. Show me.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's nothing. Just guy stuff. So if things go bad with Taylor, can't you quit cheerleading?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, I `just` said that...
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt, I [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] said that...

nodes.text: Colt starts texting back.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's not even listening to me! Who is he talking to?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can get a look at his phone if I...

nodes.prompt: I can get a look at his phone if I...

nodes.text: Sam makes entrance by cartwheeling in and running around the gym!
The Centerscore crowd cheers at the sight of Lyle!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know, if I ignore the sweaty gym sock smell, this is kind of fun!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Is it just me... Or is that lizard kind of... `hot?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Is it just me... Or is that lizard kind of... [color=#e23b3b][i]hot?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: This again, Jacob? Really?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I don't know, he's got a point! And now I'm totally pumped for the game... Go Centerscore!
Sam continues to flip and spin until the cheerleaders are done with their routine!
After the game...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Good going, Sam! You made that bulky costume look really trim out there.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, good going, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Looks like you're a natural lizard. I guess you do have pretty scaly skin...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't let her get to you. You did great!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Anyway, I'm going to run before Taylor makes me clean the gym again. I have a date with Colt!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not as fast as a motorcycle, but I have a pretty good idea of where he went.
Sam follows Colt downtown until he stops in front of an old set of apartment buildings.
Sam walks towards the apartment...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's an emergency!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: You want this skateboard? But it's my brother's.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who's your brother?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Spike?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm friends with Spike! Or I know of him. I promise I'll bring it back as soon as I can.

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks, kid!
Sam grabs the skateboard, jumps on, and...
...Falls on her knees, scraping them on the sidewalk!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ow, ow, ow!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I have no idea how to use a skateboard, but I can't go back now.
Sam hobbles to the skateboard and wheels it forward again.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just hope I can keep up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's an emergency!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: What kind of an emergency? One you'd pay for?
Sam checks her pockets.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I have a dollar, kid.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Sold!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Well, it's not really `my` bike. It's my brother Howard's!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it's not really [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] bike. It's my brother Howard's!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Even better. Thanks! I'll return it later!
Sam hops on the bike and follows Colt.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is perfect! I forgot how fun bike-riding is! I'll catch up to Colt in no time!
Sam pedals quickly down the sidewalk and around the corner.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sorry. This is important.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Wait here, and I'll come back for you. I promise.
Colt leaves.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not waiting around again!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This time, I'm going with him!
Sam leaves Bill Yard's and runs after Colt.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt! Wait!
Sam watches Colt rev his motorcycle and ride off!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now what?
Sam spots two kids, one riding a skateboard and the other a bike.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey! Kids, can I borrow your...

nodes.text: Sam walks over to Tina and tears her away from James.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Hey, what gives?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you and my boyfriend up to?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Up to? Are you crazy or something? We're just talking.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're `texting.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're [color=#3b78e2][i]texting.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Yeah. But before you freak out about it, we're texting about `poker!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. But before you freak out about it, we're texting about [color=#3b78e2][i]poker![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: We do a weekly poker night. Colt's in charge of it. What did you think we were doing?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, er...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Colt's not cheating on you. At least, not with me. Can I get back to my game now?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. Thanks.
Sam walks back to Colt.
Colt's phone rings, and he checks his phone.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What was Tina talking about?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: When?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She asked if you were getting her texts.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah. I am. So what?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what's going on there?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nothing.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? Because that's what people say when they're guilty of something.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's also what they say when `nothing is going on.` I get the feeling you don't trust me.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's also what they say when [color=#e23b3b][i]nothing is going on.[/i][/color] I get the feeling you don't trust me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't give me enough to trust. Maybe you and Tina aren't texting back and forth. Or maybe you and Mona aren't dating behind my back.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But maybe if you told me anything, I wouldn't have to ask!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I tell you everything you need to know.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What I need to know is that you aren't ditching me for some other girl!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I can't believe you.
Colt's phone rings, and he checks his phone.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We'll talk about this later.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah.
Tina leans in close to Colt.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Remember what happened after the last poker game? At that party, Colt?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Or should I say, `Domingo Florentine?` No fancy moustache this time?
nodes.text_bbcode: Or should I say, [color=#3b78e2][i]Domingo Florentine?[/i][/color] No fancy moustache this time?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: ...You know how much I `love` that moustache.
nodes.text_bbcode: ...You know how much I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] that moustache.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The only thing I remember is beating you and winning all my money back.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Hah! Speaking of which, Colt, you been getting my texts?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah. Of course.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: So, you're down for later?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'll be there.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Great. See you then.
Tina walks away to join James.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's been texting Tina? What if he really is cheating on me?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That does it! I'm going to confront...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Corner pocket.
Sam tries to hit the ball quickly! She misses!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Ooh, rookie mistake. That's too bad.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Corner pocket.
Tina takes her shot and sinks it.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: And that's game!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Way to go, Tina!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Thanks for setting that up, `Sam.` You were really helpful.
nodes.text_bbcode: Thanks for setting that up, [color=#3b78e2][i]Sam.[/i][/color] You were really helpful.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Grr.
Colt grudgingly hands James a small wad of bills.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's more than a couple bucks...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, you really shouldn't putting money on the games.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'll be sure to ask for less next time. Good game, Tina.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Good game, yourself. Pool isn't my only forte. I'm also a poker girl.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Isn't that right, Colt?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Corner pocket.
Sam shoots it straight and sinks the shot!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Not bad, Sammy. Not bad at all. This game is mine, James. Pay up.
James grudgingly hands Colt a small wad of bills.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's more than a couple bucks...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That `we` just won.
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#e23b3b][i]we[/i][/color] just won.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, you really shouldn't be taking their money...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'll be sure to take less next time.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Nice try, Tina.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: So this game really isn't my style. I'm much better at poker.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Isn't that right, Colt?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Corner pocket.
Sam hits the ball as hard as she can! The cue ball bounces off the table and nearly hits Tina!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Hey, watch it!
Tina picks up the cue ball and sets it down.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Corner pocket.
Tina takes her shot and sinks it.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: And that's game!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Way to go, Tina!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Thanks for setting that up, `Sam.` You were really helpful.
nodes.text_bbcode: Thanks for setting that up, [color=#3b78e2][i]Sam.[/i][/color] You were really helpful.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Grr.
Colt grudgingly hands James a small stack of bills.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's more than a couple bucks...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You've gone back to gambling?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You'd rather I start lifting wallets again?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess not.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Then there you go. Good game, Tina.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Good game, yourself. Pool isn't my only forte. I'm also a poker girl.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Isn't that right, Colt?
Sam stumbles blindly into the gym, weaving through jumping and kicking cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Watch it, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ow, someone just kicked me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eep! You stepped on my foot!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry, $ZOE!
Sam crashes into Maria, sending her tumbling into the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I'm starting to wish those weren't our cheerleaders. They're terrible!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Boo! Get off the court!
Sam runs off the court as the cheerleaders finish their routine.
After the game...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Sam, what happened out there?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Were you trying to inspire them or get rid of them?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not used to the costume. I couldn't even see!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That was an anti-cheer! I have half a mind to kick you off the cheer squad!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But I won't. Maybe the next basketball game, your mascot routine will be a lot better...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Because you're definitely not going back to being a cheerleader after `that.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Because you're definitely not going back to being a cheerleader after [color=#3b78e2][i]that.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe my date with Colt will cheer me up...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If he doesn't run out on me again...
That evening...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And then Taylor turns around and says...
Colt's phone beeps!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sorry, I have to answer this.
Colt texts back.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is this how every date is going to be?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? It's just a text, babe.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The last two dates we've had, it's been a text, or a phone call, or some urgent thing that's pulled you away.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How do I even know you're taking us seriously if you're not even here?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, Sammy. I promise you. I'll put the phone away. No texts.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Tonight is all about us.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks. That's all I want, Colt.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So where are we going?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I think you'll like this...
Sam and Colt sneak into Bill Yard's.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This is my favorite place to take people's money.
Colt and Sam look for an empty table, but find none.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There's always a stolen picnic in the park...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't worry. I got this.
Colt brings Sam over to a pool table where Tina and James are setting up.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, guys, looking for a challenge?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Colt! Always happy to see you.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Tina, you know this punk?

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Sounds like you do, James.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: You could say he owes me a game.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If this is about winning your money back...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're on. The usual bet.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Tina and I versus you and the little girl?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Watch who you're calling `little.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Watch who you're calling [color=#3b78e2][i]little.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You okay playing for keeps, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, I'll be honest. I've never played.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Even better.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's only a couple bucks between enemies.

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Just don't hold me back, Tina.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Please. Rack 'em up.
Tina breaks, knocking in a solid and pocketing another.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Holding you back, huh, James?
The game continues with Colt, Tina, and James making most of the shots.
Until all Sam and Colt have to do is hit the 8-ball in.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Looks like the 8-ball decides. Sam, you're up.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My last shot put the 8-ball directly in front of the corner pocket. All you have to do is hit it straight and tap it in.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Just call your shot and shoot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay. Here goes...

nodes.text: The next day, at half-time during the basketball game...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Sam, I have a very important job for you... The girl who's normally our mascot is sick...

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: You mean, Jill?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: She's the mascot...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Not today! You are!

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: What? But I don't know any of her routines!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: What's to know? Just put on the costume, get people to cheer, and stay out of our way..

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You. Are. The. `Mascot!` Don't screw it up!
nodes.text_bbcode: You. Are. The. [color=#3b78e2][i]Mascot![/i][/color] Don't screw it up!

nodes.text: Taylor hands Sam the Lyle costume and stalks off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, being at the bottom of the pyramid is bad enough. I don't want to wear that Lyle head!
Sam finishes putting on the costume as the cheerleaders run out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can barely see!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I still don't know what to do!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All right, Sam. Just get the crowd excited.
In fact, you were so close to being perfect and so close to that shiny, bonus scene!
Play again to get that perfect score!
Sam finds Colt outside an apartment building.
Colt, what is this? Is this where the other girl you're seeing lives?

nodes.speaker: Chip
nodes.text: Sammy?! You followed me?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Colt, what is this? Is this where the other girl you're seeing lives?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Ugh, I can't believe you! I told you to leave it alone.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I'm as stubborn as you are.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Yeah. You never listen to me. This isn't what it looks like.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's not some other girl's apartment. It's `mine.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not some other girl's apartment. It's [color=#e23b3b][i]mine.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You live here?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, real beauty, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, as fun as it is arguing in the dark, I don't have time for this. Just... Come in.
Sam follows Colt inside the small, two-room apartment.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maddie!
A little girl runs out of a bedroom and hugs Colt's leg.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Colt!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maddie, this is Sammy. Sammy, this is my little sister Madeline...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: The 'other girl'.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Hi, Sammy!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Er, hi, Maddie.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm going to call my mom and tell her I'm here. Think you can watch her for a minute without getting jealous?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, of course.
Colt leaves the room to place the call.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: I used the phone, and Colt came! Isn't he the bestest big brother?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He sounds like it. You text him a lot, Maddie?

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Uh-huh. All the time! I love him lots.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess it makes sense that his `little sister` would be sending him 'See you tonight' texts!
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess it makes sense that his [color=#3b78e2][i]little sister[/i][/color] would be sending him 'See you tonight' texts!

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: And Colt comes when I call. Because sometimes Dad forgets.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Colt always comes... Except when he went away to camp because he got into an accident.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He was on his way to pick you up?

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Yep! But Mom came instead because Colt had to go away.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Are you his girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I hope so.
Colt enters the room.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, Maddie, time for you to go to bed.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sammy, I have to stay here until my mom gets back, so I can't take you home, but...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's okay. Just... When you're done, come find me.
Later that night...
Sam is waiting on a park bench when Colt runs up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, I'm sorry for how I acted the last couple days.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Paranoid and jealous?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes. Why didn't you tell me you were taking care of Maddie? That was the reason you stole Tom Prince's limo, wasn't it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah. I wanted to tell you, but... What was I going to say?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I was on my way to pick up my sister because my deadbeat Dad left her alone at night?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look. I know stealing the limo was dumb. I know that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But what was I going to do? My dad left her standing alone on a dark corner in the middle of the city! She called me in tears, terrified!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My bike was out of commission, and the limo was right there... I did what I had to do.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I... I understand.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I didn't want to tell you, but I've been rushing around this entire week because my mom got a new job, and she leaves Maddie alone a lot.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, my mom's going to work to make ends meet for us, but you just don't leave your kid alone like that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So when Maddie texts, I come back to make sure she's okay.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My family's not great, but they're all I have.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry I didn't believe you when you told me I had nothing to worry about.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maybe things did look kind of suspicious.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But I swear, Sammy, I would never cheat on you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Others, maybe. But never you.
Colt kisses Sam!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Come on, let's get you home.
Sam figured out the truth about Colt. All because you played a great game!

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: Suddenly, two men dressed in black rush at Sam!
Before Sam can scream, one of the men clamps a cloth over her mouth!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Mmph!
Sam inhales chloroform!
Everything goes black.
Some indeterminate amount of time later...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ughhh... What... Just happened? Whoa, where am I?
Sam struggles but finds she's tied to a chair in an enclosed cell.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I feel like I've been here before...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Welcome, Samantha. You're here as our guest.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I'm strapped to a chair!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: More accurately, you're here as our `hostage.`
nodes.text_bbcode: More accurately, you're here as our [color=#3b78e2][i]hostage.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hostage?!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Your boyfriend, Colt, has been working on a highly secretive project with the Centerscore Secret Task Force.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt is... Colt is working `with` the law?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Colt is... Colt is working [color=#3b78e2][i]with[/i][/color] the law?!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: It came as a surprise to us too. But that's why he's the perfect undercover ops agent.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What exactly is he doing?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: He and his partner, Officer Monte, work to shut down illegal gambling rings near Centerscore University.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: The same illegal gambling rings that turn over quite a profit for the Boss.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That... is unexpected.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I still don't get why I'm here.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Thanks to your paranoia and jealousy, you've gotten too close to Colt. And you're witness to most of his dealings.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: This information will be extremely useful in getting rid of Colt and Monte before they shut us down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's why he's been getting all those phone calls and texts...

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: The texts are coded messages.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And meeting up with all those girls!

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: The girls are secret agents working for Internal Affairs. It turns out Officer Monte is a double agent who is actually working for the KGB!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Oh, I just like kidnapping people.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I shouldn't be here! I didn't even know who he was talking to! I don't know anything about his secret police dealings.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Maybe you don't, maybe you do. But that doesn't matter because you are his girlfriend, and he `will` come for you.
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe you don't, maybe you do. But that doesn't matter because you are his girlfriend, and he [color=#3b78e2][i]will[/i][/color] come for you.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: And once he does, we'll deal with Colt once and for all.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: All we have to do is wait...
Steph leaves Sam in the empty jail cell.

nodes.text: Hostage?!

nodes.text: Your boyfriend, Colt, has been working on a highly secretive project with the Centerscore Secret Task Force.

nodes.text: It came as a surprise to us too. But that's why he's the perfect undercover ops agent.

nodes.text: What exactly is he doing?

nodes.text: He and his partner, Officer Monte, work to shut down illegal gambling rings near Centerscore University.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: The same illegal gambling rings that turn over quite a profit for the Boss.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That... is unexpected.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I still don't get why I'm here.

nodes.text: Thanks to your paranoia and jealousy, you've gotten too close to Colt. And you're witness to most of his dealings.

nodes.text: That's why he's been getting all those phone calls and texts...

nodes.text: The texts are coded messages.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And meeting up with all those girls!

nodes.text: The girls are secret agents working for Internal Affairs. It turns out Officer Monte is a double agent who is actually working for the KGB!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Oh, I just like kidnapping people.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I shouldn't be here! I didn't even know who he was talking to! I don't know anything about his secret police dealings.

nodes.speaker: Steph
nodes.text: Maybe you don't, maybe you do. But that doesn't matter because you are his girlfriend, and he `will` come for you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maddie!

nodes.text: Colt!

nodes.text: Hi, Sammy!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Er, hi, Maddie.

nodes.speaker: Colt

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Are you his girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: All right, Maddie, time for you to go to bed.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Colt

nodes.speaker: Sam

Sam is waiting on a park bench when Colt runs up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt, I'm sorry for how I acted the last couple days.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Paranoid and jealous?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes. Why didn't you tell me you were taking care of Maddie? That was the reason you stole Tom Prince's limo, wasn't it?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah. I wanted to tell you, but... What was I going to say?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I was on my way to pick up my sister because my deadbeat Dad left her alone at night?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Colt...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look. I know stealing the limo was dumb. I know that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But what was I going to do? My dad left her standing alone on a dark corner in the middle of the city! She called me in tears, terrified!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My bike was out of commission, and the limo was right there... I did what I had to do.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I... I understand.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And I didn't want to tell you, but I've been rushing around this entire week because my mom got a new job, and she leaves Maddie alone a lot.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, my mom's going to work to make ends meet for us, but you just don't leave your kid alone like that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So when Maddie texts, I come back to make sure she's okay.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: My family's not great, but they're all I have.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry I didn't believe you when you told me I had nothing to worry about.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Maybe things did look kind of suspicious.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But I swear, Sammy, I would never cheat on you.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...Others, maybe. But never you.
